explanation: The Almighty Creator who has given the words of salvation through Jesus Christ, the greatest prophet.
The Son of Man who was made lower than the angels for a short time and suffered death to defeat death.
Souls of light who are ministering spirits sent out to serve those who will inherit salvation, but do not have the same authority as Jesus.
The common fate all humans must undergo because of sin, which Jesus overcame through his own death and resurrection.
The concept of being saved from the punishment of sins and the power of death through Jesus' sacrificial death and his compassion as high priest.
Transgression of God's law that leads to separation between humanity and God, which Jesus came to cleanse us from.
The title for Jesus who entered heaven after his death to represent people before God and show compassion toward their weakness.
